posts.hook: CFOs are raising 2026 tech budgets, but treasury automation has held near 48% for years.
posts.key_stat: Most CFOs plan higher 2026 tech spend, yet core treasury automation averages 48%.
posts.source: Gartner CFO Budget Priorities Survey; Euromoney 2026 Economic Outlook
posts.visual_direction: Contrast a rising budget arrow against a flat 48% automation line to show the spend-automation mismatch.
